help.board.rules:
On the 8 squares of the board, Locations are available for both players.
On each side of the board, each player has a track which runs from 0 to 8.
For each player, the cards located between their square 1 and the current position of their Exploration counter are accessible: these Locations can be discovered immediately. The other Locations can only be reserved.
help.token.rules:
{player}'s Exploration counter gives 2 pieces of information:
- the number of <0/> available for this turn.
- the area in which the cards are available.

help.card.points.family.adjacent: This card is worth <0>2 Victory Points</0> for each card of the <1/> family <0>adjacent</0> to it.

help.card.effect.pick: Choose a card from the board and <0>put it in your reserve</0>.
help.card.effect.remove: Choose a card from the board and <0>remove it</0> from the game.

help.scoring.rules:
Each player adds up the Victory Points of the cards in their pyramid. The player with the most Victory Points wins the game.
In the event of a tie, the player with the fewest cards in their pyramid wins. If the tie persists, victory is shared.

tuto.goal:
In Boreal, you're a young explorer in search of new discoveries.
Your goal is to discover <0>Locations</0> in order to gather more <1/> <0>Victory Points</0> than your best friend (Yuko in this tutorial).
tuto.place.starting: Here are the 8 starting Location cards.
tuto.exploration.token:
Here's your <0>Exploration counter</0>.
It's next to the number 5, because you start the game with 5 <1/> <0>Compasses</0>.
You have the Exploration counter with the white arrow so you start the game.
tuto.exploration.phase: Your turn begins with the <0>Exploration phase</0>, during which you have 2 possible actions: <0>Discover</0> or <0>Locate</0> a Location.
tuto.discover:
Let's start with <0>Discovering a Location</0>.
Only these 5 Locations are <0>accessible</0> to be discovered: a Location is <0>accessible</0> if it is located between square 1 and the position of your <0>Exploration counter</0>.
tuto.discover.place: Take this Location and place it here to Discover it.
tuto.cost: Each Location costs a number of <0>Compasses</0>, shown here.
tuto.pay: Your <0>Exploration counter</0> will automatically be moved to square 3, to pay the cost of 2 Compasses.
tuto.savior:
This Location gives you 4 Victory Points, shown here.
The player with the most Victory Points at the end of the game wins!
tuto.rest.phase:
Your <0>Exploration phase</0> is over. It is now your <0>Rest phase</0>.
During the <0>Rest phase</0>, the Locations you've discovered automatically give you <0>Compasses</0>, shown here.
tuto.rest.gain: Your <0>Exploration counter</0> will be moved to square 4, as you gain <0>1 Compass</0> thanks to your Location.
tuto.opponent.discover:
Your opponent has discovered this Location, and paid <0>4 Compasses</0>.
As you can see, her <0>Exploration counter</0> follows a track that goes in the opposite direction to yours: some Locations are therefore easier to discover for her, others easier for you.
tuto.place.help: <0>Tip</0>: at any time, click on a Location to see its effect.
tuto.opponent.rest:
It's now your opponent's <0>Rest phase</0>.
Her <0>Exploration counter</0> is on square 1: this bonus indicates that she regains <0>1 additional Compass</0>.
With her Location, she therefore regains <0>2 Compasses</0>.
tuto.place.2: Now it's your turn. Discover this Location and place it to the right of the Location you've already discovered.
tuto.effect.left: This Location has an end-of-game effect: it yields as many Victory Points as the card to its left (here 4 points).
tuto.bonus.0: You regain <0>4 Compasses</0> during your <0>Rest phase</0>: 2 for your 2 Locations, +2 because your Exploration counter is on square 0.
tuto.opponent.2:
Your opponent has discovered this Location.
It's your turn again.
tuto.reserve.1: You're interested in this Location because it gives you 2 Compasses each turn, but you can't Discover it because your Exploration counter is too low.
tuto.reserve.2: During your <0>Exploration phase</0>, instead of <0>Discovering</0> a Location, you can <0>Locate</0> a Location, to reserve it for yourself.
tuto.reserve.place: Take this Location and reserve it by placing it in this area.
tuto.reserve.free:
Reserving a Location does not cost any <0>Compasses</0>. You will only pay the cost of the Location if you choose to Discover it on another turn.
What's more, your opponent won't be able to Discover a Location you've reserved.
tuto.rest.2: It is now your <0>Rest phase</0>. You earn 2 Compasses.
tuto.discover.reserve: It's your turn. It's time to Discover the Location you've reserved.
tuto.pyramid.max: The Locations you discover must be placed in such a way as to form this 10-card pyramid.
tuto.pyamid.top: You can place your 3rd Location at any of these 3 positions: it is in fact possible to place a card on a higher floor of the pyramid <0>as soon as 2 cards are present below</0>.
tuto.compass.ignored: <0>Beware though:</0> as soon as a Location has at least one other card above it, <0>it no longer produces a Compass during the Rest phase!</0>
tuto.place.baseline: Place your Location to the right or left of your pyramid, so you don't lose the 2 Compasses produced by your first 2 Locations.
tuto.effects:
Some cards have placement effects. For example, this one allows you to reserve a card when you place it in your pyramid.
Other cards have end-of-game effects.
<0>Click on a card to discover its effect!</0>
tuto.end.trigger:
When a player has discovered 10 Locations and completed their pyramid, the game ends at the end of the turn of the player with the Exploration counter with the black arrow (so that each player has played the same number of turns).
<0>The player with the most Victory Points</0> in their pyramid wins.
tuto.go:
Now you're free to make your own choices!
Don't forget: at any time, you can click on a card to discover its effect.
Enjoy your exploration, adventurer!
tuto.over:
Congratulations, you've completed the tutorial!
Ready to play with other players?
